title: Which of these powers make the same number?
description: Five numbers are written as powers of two, three, six and eighteen. Each is rewritten with the bases two and three, and the matching ones are confirmed by multiplying out.
teaching_notes: One idea: splitting every base into twos and threes makes numbers comparable at a glance. Watch for students who compare only the exponents or only the bases.

video_script.why: The child can multiply powers by pairing their bases and now splits every base into twos and threes to compare five numbers.
video_script.substitution: The five numbers in the book, each rewritten with the bases two and three and then multiplied out.
video_script.anchor: five numbers on the board, each rewritten as twos and threes
video_script.payoff_line: Three of the five numbers are the same number

final_answer.value: 2⁴ × 3 to the power 6, 6⁴ × 3² and 18² × 6² are the same number, 11664
final_answer.spoken: two to the power four times three to the power six, six to the power four times three squared and eighteen squared times six squared are the same number, eleven thousand six hundred sixty four

never_show: the value of the matching numbers before the answer beat
video_script.design: One idea: split every base into twos and threes. The five numbers stay on the board all video; the common value is held until the answer; the check multiplies out the pieces.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about equal numbers.
<bookmark mark='five'/>Five numbers are written with powers of two, three, six and eighteen.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Which of them are the same number?
And how can we be sure?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.
<bookmark mark='six'/>Six is two multiplied by three.
<bookmark mark='split'/>Six to the power four is two to the power four times three to the power four.

marks.rest: the other four numbers are written under it

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, five numbers.
Two to the power four times three to the power six.
Six to the power four times three squared.
Six to the power ten.
<bookmark mark='rest'/>Eighteen squared times six squared, and six to the power twenty four.

beats.on_screen: To find: which of the five numbers are the same; check by multiplying out
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find which of them are the same number.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Then we check by multiplying out.
<bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, take six to the power four times three squared.
<bookmark mark='split'/>Split the six into two times three, the same way as the example in your book.
<bookmark mark='becomes'/>Six to the power four becomes two to the power four times three to the power four.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Three to the power four times three squared makes three to the power six.

marks.join: 6² = 2² × 3² and the joined result 2⁴ × 3⁶ are written

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, take eighteen squared times six squared.
Eighteen is two times three times three.
<bookmark mark='sq'/>Eighteen squared is two squared times three to the power four.
Six squared is two squared times three squared.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Together that is two to the power four times three to the power six.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, take six to the power ten and six to the power twenty four.
Six to the power ten has ten twos and ten threes.
<bookmark mark='big'/>Six to the power twenty four has twenty four twos and twenty four threes.
<bookmark mark='differ'/>Their exponents are not four and six, so they differ.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Step four, check by multiplying out.
<bookmark mark='sixteen'/>Sixteen times eighty one is one thousand two hundred ninety six.
<bookmark mark='conf1'/>That confirms six to the power four splits into the twos and threes.
<bookmark mark='nine'/>Eighty one times nine is seven hundred twenty nine.
<bookmark mark='conf2'/>That confirms three to the power four times three squared is three to the power six.
<bookmark mark='dur'/>Eighteen times six is one hundred eight, which is two squared times three cubed.
<bookmark mark='sq'/>Squaring one hundred eight gives two to the power four times three to the power six.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 2⁴ × 3⁶, 6⁴ × 3² and 18² × 6² are the same number, 11664

marks.a1: the three matching numbers are circled
marks.a4: 16 × 729 = 11664 is written, and 1296 × 9 and 324 × 36 are written equal to it

narration: <bookmark mark='a1'/>Three of the five numbers are the same number.
<bookmark mark='a2'/>One is two to the power four times three to the power six.
Another is six to the power four times three squared.
<bookmark mark='a3'/>The third is eighteen squared times six squared.
<bookmark mark='a4'/>Sixteen times seven hundred twenty nine is eleven thousand six hundred sixty four.
The other two pairs give eleven thousand six hundred sixty four as well.
